findings_qualitative.value: Polarization in envelope is mainly from magnetically aligned grains, with pinched poloidal field and point-symmetric polarization implying a toroidal component

evidence.quote: a point symmetric polarization distribution is also seen in the flattened envelope, implying that the pinched field lines also have a significant toroidal component generated by the rotation.

claims.hypothesis: The flattened envelope is a pseudodisk with infall and rotation
claims.experiment: C18O PV diagram fit with ballistic infall-rotation model
claims.result: l~55±15 au km/s, centrifugal barrier ~21 au
claims.finding: Envelope spirals inward and becomes a disk at ~20 au

evidence.quote: It is spiraling inwards and expected to transform into a rotating disk at $\sim$ 20 au

claims.hypothesis: Constant specific angular momentum results from inside-out collapse of the NH3 envelope
claims.experiment: Compare Shu model applied to NH3 l_e(r) with C18O l
claims.finding: Flattened envelope comes from thin shell of extended envelope

evidence.quote: the collapsing model here at $t_c \sim 35000$ yr fits the observed distribution of specific angular momentum in the C$^{18}$O flattened envelope reasonably well

claims.hypothesis: Field in the envelope is pinched with toroidal component
claims.experiment: 232/358 GHz polarization maps compared to Hirano2019 and Kataoka2012 simulations
claims.result: Pinched field lines and point-symmetric polarization
claims.finding: Pseudodisk threaded by toroidal and pinched poloidal field

evidence.quote: Deeper polarization observations are needed to consolidate this pinched field morphology by detecting more polarization on the east side of the envelope.
